title: Message/set update: readAt accepts unclamped timestamps (far future / past)
description: process_update stores owner-supplied readAt verbatim (including 2099-01-01) in read_at_unix. This timestamp is used for receipt 'at' sent to the peer, and potentially for UI ordering. Far-future timestamps produce a receipt 'at' value the peer must ignore per spec, but could break UI sort order locally. Fix: clamp readAt to [message.created_at, now+tolerance] before storing.
